item.title: Freeze warnings issued for parts of north Alabama - Franklin County Times
item.description: HUNTSVILLE — The National Weather Service has issued a freeze warning for portions of north central, northeast, and northwest Alabama. The first warning is in effect from 8 p.m. Monday to 10 a.m. Tuesday, with temperatures expected to drop as low as 17 degrees. A second warning runs from 9 p.m. Tuesday to 9 a.m. Wednesday, with lows near 28 degrees. Officials warn that frost and freeze conditions could harm crops,...

item.title: Red Bay community garden prepares for second season - Franklin County Times
item.description: RED BAY — Red Bay’s community garden is heading into its second season with a new distribution plan and an electric fence aimed at protecting this year’s crops from the deer that damaged part of last year’s harvest.

item.title: City schools consider joint purchasing group - Franklin County Times
item.description: RUSSELLVILLE — A new county animal control facility is set to be built next to the Franklin County Jail with construction expected to begin by month’s end, Franklin County Commissioner Greg Hovater said.

item.title: Hadrian, Navy partnering on project - Franklin County Times
item.description: BARTON — Federal and local officials are gearing up for Friday’s public unveiling of a major defense project at the Barton Riverfront Industrial Park U.S. Rep. Robert Aderholt confirmed last week Hadrian is partnering with the U.S. Navy on the project.

item.title: Hail damage to cost $400K - Franklin County Times
item.description: R U S S E L L V I L L E — Hailstorm damage at Russellville Middle School is expected to cost about $400,000 to repair, Superintendent Dr. Tim Guinn told the city schools board of education during its March 12 work session.

item.title: Hardware store hosts newest Connie’s Cabinet - Franklin County Times
item.description: RUSSELLVILLE — Austin Williams said Monday he hopes a cabinet in front of Green’s Dependable Hardware helps those in need for food but also serves as a reminder of the type of kindness his mother displayed.

item.title: Pilgrim’s renovations will add 100 jobs - Franklin County Times
item.description: RUSSELLVILLE — Pilgrim’s Pride’s poultry processing plant is undergoing a total overhaul that when completed will create 100 additional jobs.

item.title: Russellville BOE receives clean audit report - Franklin County Times
item.description: RUSSELLVILLE — The Russellville City Schools Board of Education received a clean financial audit for fiscal 2025 during its meeting on Tuesday.Buddy Johnsey of Watkins Johnsey Professional Group presented the report.

item.title: PC’s Bullington sets AHSAA record - Franklin County Times
item.description: Phil Campbell’s Chaley Bullington set an AHSAA record with a 7-for-7 performance in a 23-12 win over Red Bay. Bullington drove in six runs and scored five times to highlight a busy spring sports scheduled for Franklin County teams.
